review_scope: Read-only audit of the 45-row Consumption ledger in RETURN-design.md; no board, asset, merge, deployment, or product acceptance.

counts.count_note: Verified: the 36 vendor manifest entries are 35 SVG files plus LICENSE; the 24-name ui-controls allowlist is separate. Current product-semantics registry has 47 entries, 30 non-null glyphRefs, and 22 unique glyph names. The return/HANDOFF phrase 36 semantic glyphs is not independently verified against that current registry.

rows.review: Scout is correctly treated as data above local authority.
rows.action: Keep the local source path in the audit; do not promote Scout to a grammar authority.

rows.review: The precedent→grammar→primitive→real-content chain is supported.
rows.action: Keep real-content specimens bounded to the return.

rows.review: Problem-key routing and the app/public-site boundary match the accepted Scout decision.
rows.action: No change.

rows.review: Four dispositions are supported, but the named sparkle/bell/eye/strike anti-examples are not established by the cited intake rows.
rows.action: Cite the local board or anti-example record and do not imply Scout accepted those exact glyphs.

rows.review: The pilot records 1 specimen/7 ignore; final accepted disposition is 8/8 ignore in §4an. “No status tint anywhere” conflicts with bounded needs_you review color.
rows.action: Use §4an as authority, pilot as evidence, and narrow the effect to material not carrying state.

rows.review: Section sweep is correctly deferred and the contextual-toolbar gap remains open.
rows.action: Treat “no open row needed” as return scope, not a new source decision.

rows.review: Pull cadence and no standing subscription are supported.
rows.action: No change.

rows.review: Method is correctly consumed without authorizing tokens, controls, dependencies, or style.
rows.action: No change.

rows.review: The semantic rule is valid, but the cited frontend contract does not itself prove Spark never-zero and Explore thread-scoping examples.
rows.action: Add direct projection and owner-contract locators.

rows.review: Atlas supports separation, but the listed Rebuild, Explore ladder, and chat-gap examples need direct source anchors.
rows.action: Retain sample labels and add direct implementation/capability locators.

rows.review: Reuse and bounded numeric-control treatment are supported.
rows.action: No new row type; retain the unit/bounds/commit condition.

rows.review: The shell precedent is valid, but header-pair fix and alternative B are return recommendations, not accepted SE-04 facts.
rows.action: Mark the visual choice candidate/adapt and cite the local implementation/board source.

rows.review: Tooltip, popover, menu, and dialog classification/focus rules match the contract.
rows.action: Keep contextual toolbar deferred.

rows.review: Two registered blur consumers and solid content planes are supported.
rows.action: Keep Pages atmosphere as a separate namespace/specimen.

rows.review: Return cites 3299730, which is the Scout layer input rather than the fixed Visual Grammar source.
rows.action: Replace the source pin with 5a6d8ac5fcffbcf77d90ad27a58ba3e3a317055; retain the role→token/no-parallel-system conclusion.

rows.review: Review is explicit label plus structure/icon, with color supplementary; “word/weight” is not the governed claim, and needs_you has bounded review color.
rows.action: Rewrite the row to label+structure/icon and skin independence; do not claim color is absent.

rows.review: No new radii, composer-only pill, and square glyph slots match the current grammar.
rows.action: Keep as grammar/specimen guidance pending implementation review.

rows.review: Lucide family and 35 SVG count are supported, but the proposed `text` donor has no fixed source SHA: `icons/text.svg` is 404; `text-align-start.svg` is not yet verified as the selected donor.
rows.action: Defer donor/manifest/semantic admission until exact path, SHA, license, geometry, optical, and accessibility evidence exists.

rows.review: Dark authored surface maps to existing float; light remains unchanged and cards/overlays are out of scope.
rows.action: Keep this as a narrow preference/amendment, not blanket Visual Grammar acceptance.

rows.review: Read projection, Refresh reread, and sample-only Rebuild treatment are supported.
rows.action: Do not infer a new backend rebuild action.

rows.review: Correctly delegates to the L0 protocol rows.
rows.action: No change.

rows.review: Capture evidence supports a Pages specimen, not product acceptance or deployment.
rows.action: Keep the effect labeled evidence/specimen and preserve the f137 source pin.

rows.review: EX-IC2 recall-only and non-ancestry are supported, but convergence alone does not establish WO-VS-01 action coverage.
rows.action: Cite chat-actions.mjs and the direct WO-VS-01 evidence; keep capability ledger unchanged.

rows.review: Bounded chronology makes no additional PR-state or acceptance claim.
rows.action: Keep chronology separate from acceptance.

rows.review: Navigation retains text; governed actions retain words; Retry and Continue remain distinct.
rows.action: No change.

rows.review: Tooltip and decision-point disclosure treatment match the contract.
rows.action: Keep a11y/keyboard/touch checks as open verification for implementation.

rows.review: BBox computation is recorded; circle/square blur comparison and device checks were not run.
rows.action: Keep unverified and do not admit the glyphs as canonical.

rows.review: Explore reuses the existing row anatomy rather than creating a new row type.
rows.action: Keep the Explore ladder itself sample-only.

rows.review: No new blur consumer is proposed.
rows.action: No change.

rows.review: Maturity is order in density, spacing/alignment, and hierarchy before decoration; “no colour or rule” is too absolute because semantic color exists.
rows.action: Narrow the effect to constructing hierarchy without decorative color/rules.

rows.review: Exact grant, no Always allow, and Auto as a strategy-layer mode are supported.
rows.action: Keep Auto out of the authorization-card button set.

rows.review: Current attention-view.mjs implements production POST actions, request identity/CAS, receipt validation, recovery, and re-inspection. “All drawn states/actions are live” still overstates what the current source proves; action availability depends on each item’s advertised typed actions. WK-158’s read-only wording is historical and must not be applied to the current implementation.
rows.action: Separate the implemented mutation protocol and source-backed states from per-item capability/action coverage and any remaining backend gaps.

rows.review: Sample data is gated, labeled, read-only, and cannot navigate as live data.
rows.action: Preserve sample/live separation in any implementation.

rows.review: Layer→role→state is adapted without importing Carbon values.
rows.action: No change.

rows.review: Bounded elevation vocabulary is adapted to local frame/panel/float/scrim roles.
rows.action: Do not add a raised tier without local evidence.

rows.review: On-role relation is used as vocabulary/method, not as imported token naming or business semantics.
rows.action: No change.

rows.review: Radix numeric palette is rejected as a token source while state-slot decomposition is adapted.
rows.action: No change.

rows.review: Registered chrome/transient glass and solid content match the local material grammar.
rows.action: Require fallback, legibility, reduced-transparency, and performance evidence before implementation.

rows.review: Persistent/transient/blocking lifetime mapping is supported as a method.
rows.action: Do not import Acrylic/Mica/Smoke CSS or blur values as Courtwork tokens.

rows.review: Expressive serif is correctly confined to an explicit Pages/editorial slot.
rows.action: Keep controls, tables, and composer on the productive type precedent.

rows.review: Behavior vocabulary is referenced without dependency, capability, or default-blur adoption.
rows.action: Keep local owners and state contracts authoritative.

rows.review: Rejecting required fades matches the local static reduced-motion rule.
rows.action: Keep this as an external-claim rejection, not a new product rule.

rows.review: Rejection matches final 8/8 ignore and material/state separation.
rows.action: Use final intake §4an as the disposition source.

rows.review: No Courtwork dataset or acceptance claim is made for the conceptual figure.
rows.action: Keep it out of product evidence and measurement claims.

rows.review: Narrow dark float mapping, light unchanged, and cards/overlays untouched are supported.
rows.action: Keep as preference/amendment follow-up, not general Visual Grammar acceptance.
